sections.heading: Section B: Written Questions (76 marks)
items: 1. State two differences between plant and animal cells. (2 marks)
2. Name the parts of the flower labelled in the diagram and state the function of each. (6 marks)
3. Explain the process of photosynthesis and write its word equation. (4 marks)
4. State two functions of blood in the human body. (2 marks)
5. What is the difference between aerobic and anaerobic respiration? (2 marks)
6. Name three parts of the human digestive system and state one function of each. (6 marks)
7. State two adaptations of a leaf for photosynthesis. (2 marks)
